comparison.objective: Press three culture-tube caps to an intermediate vented detent.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated axial alignment and depth/force control to stop at the first snap position.
comparison.success_condition: All caps centered, upright, and 4–6 mm depressed, still for 1 s; over-seating fails that tube.
comparison.reason: Tests precision partial seating at a detent, not bimanual screen agitation or selective retention.
